recognize_zh: 兩格視野各有一顆胞質呈泡沫狀、多空泡的巨噬細胞，胞質內可見數顆已被消化、深染縮小的細胞核殘骸位於吞噬體（phagosome）中，代表骨髓巨噬細胞正在消化被吞噬的細胞。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale, foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Round eccentric nucleus with fine chromatin and a small nucleolus
Multiple small, dense, pyknotic nuclear remnants of ingested cells within cytoplasmic phagosomes
Occasional clear vacuoles adjacent to the ingested material
Background of red cells; panel A shows drying artifact with refractile central inclusions in erythrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (panels A and B) shows isolated macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and bland round nuclei. Each contains several small, dense, condensed nuclear remnants of phagocytosed cells within cytoplasmic phagosomes, representing late-stage digestion of ingested hematopoietic cells. The background red cells in panel A show drying artifact. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis with intracellular digestion; clinical and laboratory correlation is required before attributing this to hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of variable size from local cell turnover rather than recognizable whole ingested cells, a distinction that becomes difficult once digestion is advanced.
Storage cells have uniformly bubbly lipid-laden cytoplasm without ingested nuclear remnants.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse blue-black to golden granules confirmed by Prussian blue, not as round condensed nuclei within phagosomes.
